session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Higher High Double Top Then Higher Low Double Bottom'. Overnight ET+12 chart: a higher high double top at 5917 sells into the 5895 range until the higher low double bottom fails; a sell climax tight channel reaches the measured move down low at 5858, then a wedge reversal breakout above the trading range drives a measured move up to the buy climax at 5931 before the market closes at 5913.
